data_description.mode: Choose to filter by administrative district or by a coordinate + radius.
data_description.location: Pick a position on the map. Defaults to your Home Assistant home location.
data_description.radius_km: Defaults to 10 km. Alerts are matched if their area passes within this radius.
data_description.exclude_sea: Exclude marine warnings (e.g., sea level, wind at sea).
data_description.include_messages: The integration always shows warnings. Enable this option to also show messages, which can, for example, be a risk.
data_description.include_geometry: Attach GeoJSON geometry for each warning area to the sensor attributes so UI cards can draw the affected area. This can increase entity state size.
data_description.message_types: Choose which message categories to include when Show messages is enabled.
data_description.fire_risk_enabled: Create separate sensors for forest fire risk, grass fire risk and forest fuel drying, with daily forecasts. These forecasts do not affect issued warning counts and do not indicate whether a fire ban applies.
data_description.fire_risk_location: Choose or confirm the exact forecast point, also when warnings use a district. The initial suggestion is your Home Assistant home location. SMHI provides this product for land and inland waters in Sweden; other points can have no data. The warning radius does not apply.
data_description.thunder_probability_enabled: Show thunderstorm probability at the next forecast time and the forecast for the coming 48 hours. This is a local forecast, not an issued warning.
data_description.thunder_probability_location: Choose or confirm the exact forecast point. The initial suggestion is your Home Assistant home location. This point is independent of the warning filter and fire risk location; the warning radius does not apply. Points outside SMHI’s forecast area can have no data.
data_description.winter_enabled: Show precipitation type, frozen precipitation probability and temperature at the next forecast time, with a forecast for the coming 48 hours. These are local forecasts, not snow depth, road conditions or issued warnings.
data_description.winter_location: Choose or confirm the exact forecast point. The initial suggestion is your Home Assistant home location. This point is independent of the warning filter and other local forecasts; the warning radius does not apply. Points outside SMHI’s forecast area can have no data.
data_description.snow_depth_enabled: Add snow depth measured at a station you choose in the next step. The station can be far from home and does not describe snow depth at your exact location. No station is selected automatically.
data_description.snow_depth_change_station: Open the station list to change or confirm the station and observation source. Other settings can be saved without checking this box.
data_description.wind_enabled: Show the next wind gust forecast and the highest forecast value in the next 24 hours. This is a local forecast, not an issued warning.
data_description.precipitation_enabled: Show the probability of at least 0.1 mm precipitation and expected precipitation for each entire SMHI interval. Intervals can have different lengths.
data_description.analysis_enabled: Show SMHI analysed precipitation and snow amount change in the latest analysed hour, with up to 24 hours of history. This describes past weather, not measured snow depth or a forecast.
data_description.wind_location: Choose or confirm the location. This point is independent of the warning filter and other data sources. Points outside SMHI coverage can have no data.
data_description.precipitation_location: Choose or confirm the location. This point is independent of the warning filter and other data sources. Points outside SMHI coverage can have no data.
data_description.analysis_location: Choose or confirm the location. This point is independent of the warning filter and other data sources. Points outside SMHI coverage can have no data.

reload_notice.title: SMHI Alert
reload_notice.description: Setup is complete. Click submit to finish. After setup, reload the browser page once to make sure the dashboard card is available immediately.

snow_depth.title: Snow depth observation station
snow_depth.description: Choose a station and source. Stations are ordered by distance from your Home Assistant home location. Source 8 reports a daily observation at 06 UTC; source 52 is labelled as minute observations in SMHI’s catalogue, but individual stations may report less often. The sensor always shows the actual observation time and source. Only the selected station is checked for recent data before saving. If the selected source has no recent observation, choose another station or source.

data_description.snow_depth_station: Labels show station name, distance from home and SMHI’s source description. Confirm your selection; the nearest station is never chosen automatically.
